protocol.test_policy: one closed phase after source and checkpoint suite freeze
protocol.training: all first-six-day exposures; natural class ratio; Adam or declared candidate optimizer/loss; scratch initialization
protocol.static_snapshot_assumption: Publisher-provided user/ad snapshots treated as static benchmark attributes. Their as-of dates are undocumented; this is not verified production point-in-time data.

context.budget_scope: all preparation, calibration, research calls, failures, controls and final assessment count

knowledge_review.policy: Evaluate relevant external references against local evidence; adoption is optional. Missing source detail and negative transfer remain explicit.
knowledge_review.proposal_output: Add top-level knowledge_assessments: [{knowledge_id, decision: used|considered|rejected|unresolved, rationale, transformed_mechanism, variant_names, nearest_work_difference, falsifier}]. Cover retrieved industry cards; identify the concrete changed mechanism for used cards. This is provenance, not causal proof.
knowledge_review.reflection: Review the latest knowledge-usage.json alongside outcomes; distinguish declared use, executed changes, mechanism evidence and unresolved attribution.

assessments.rationale: Reviewed the prior declared use against local removal outcomes and primary tiny-mode section 5.3. Source-motivated total attention removal did not preserve local quality (.617127 to .613095). That failed transfer motivates a narrower replacement retaining learned event values; it does not refute the source system.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: Replace target-conditioned attention by mean or content-only weighted learned values alongside inherited direct match counts, crossed with N-only controls.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: No FM Highway, per-layer dots, buses, delay labels, source split or optimizer. Retains a shallow single summary; no global novelty or source-system reproduction.
assessments.falsifier: If replacements do not retain quality at measured benefit, local attention simplification remains unsupported. More source citation cannot override the negative result.

assessments.rationale: Primary section 5.2 Table 4 reports query-related ablation losses in another setting. Use as competing evidence and a reason to test query necessity before expanding queries, not as evidence it transfers.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: Zero only the query input to the existing event scorer, crossed with explicit target-match counts and activity-only slots. Mean variants distinguish query removal from learned weighting removal.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: No generated probes, field bridge, packed multi-view execution or source training. Reduced active input rank remains a confound despite identical allocated scorer parameters.
assessments.falsifier: If content-only loses materially to target-aware weighting even with explicit matches, query-free sufficiency fails locally. This does not validate QueryFormer query generation.

assessments.rationale: Card reviewed; no local depth/transport instability diagnosed. Primary transport mechanism not audited in this turn.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: None; no transport gate or deep memory routing.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Single summary weighting substitution in a shallow model; source reliability-gated propagation is untested.
assessments.falsifier: Reconsider only after an admissible matched-depth diagnostic identifies propagation instability. This suite neither validates nor refutes the source mechanism.

assessments.rationale: Organizer-level card only. Earlier action partition contrasts did not improve the reference; no old/recent complementary-utility contrast exists.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: None; no older-history compression, dual paths or gated exchange.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Same visible 128-event prefix and one summary; no domain interpretation of behavior types.
assessments.falsifier: Reconsider if controlled age/type marginal utility is observed. Uniform pooling is not a test of UniDAC.

assessments.rationale: Organizer-level card only; local field_values underperformed collapsed_values. This failed local finer-granularity branch is retained as evidence, not generalized to all tokenization.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: None; no learned token allocation or sequence decoder.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Changes weights within the existing summary width rather than allocating additional tokens.
assessments.falsifier: Revisit on controlled evidence of a field-specific bottleneck; this suite cannot refute the full source architecture.

latest_knowledge_usage.limits: A declared source-to-code link is provenance, not a causal estimate of knowledge value or a novelty score.

context.final_assessment_scope: validation only; no test scores or predictions are supplied

reference_format: Use allowed_observation_ids verbatim for local evidence. Descriptive references are accepted when they contain a complete known ID. Correct any previous_runtime_error before submitting; its failed costs remain charged.
action: Read candidate.py and baseline_reference.py, diagnose an observed limitation, check primary nearest work, and implement a feasible candidate. Write proposal.json containing study (matching study_schema), parent_trial (existing trial ID), and variants (1-4 objects with distinct name, file basename ending .py, role candidate/control, config object, and note). At least one candidate is required. Add key ablations or matched controls for the claimed mechanism when feasible; reference existing matched trials as controls where justified. Each variant is a standalone module. Do not run training. New architecture choices come from evidence; industry cards do not mandate them.

candidate_api.Model: Model(meta, config) -> torch.nn.Module; forward(batch) -> finite [B] logits
optional: literal CONFIG dictionary for model dimensions/lr

Model.diagnostics(batch) -> at most 64 named finite scalars; host calls this on the first 512 validation impressions at the frozen best checkpoint, under no_grad. These are candidate-supplied measurements, requiring source-level scrutiny and controls.
candidate_api.ownership: Edit or create only candidate model modules and proposal.json. No filesystem/network access from model code. Numeric imports only: torch,numpy,math,typing,copy,functools,collections,itertools,dataclasses,contextlib.
candidate_api.local_checks: Torch is not installed in the coding jail. Perform syntax/source checks there; host training and scoring follow automatically. Do not install packages or wait for human review.
candidate_api.training: from scratch; fixed host epochs, data, sample coverage, supplied history, scorer and seeds; optional optimizer/loss changes require explicit attribution controls
